product: Connectors section in Genie Agent settings (Beta)
tagline: The Configure settings for a Genie Agent now have a dedicated section for adding connectors.
what_it_does: The Configure settings for a Genie Agent now have a dedicated section for adding connectors. This feature is in Beta. A Genie Agent can use Databricks provided MCP (Model Context Protocol) connectors to pull context from and take actions in external tools and sources during an Agent mode conversation.
why_it_matters: Databricks governs every tool call through Unity Catalog and Unity Gateway.
plain_summary: The Configure settings for a Genie Agent now have a dedicated section for adding connectors. This feature is in Beta.
key_takeaway: The Configure settings for a Genie Agent now have a dedicated section for adding connectors.
